title: More Context, Same Budget: Dual-Bounded Relational Recall Beyond Top-K Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.18448v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: More context does not require a larger retrieval budget. Under the same ceiling, a retrieval system can recover more of the evidence a question requires by following relationships between evidence that flat top-k ranking leaves behind. We test that proposition with Dual-Bounded Relational Recall (DBRR), which allocates a fixed retrieval budget between relevance-selected seeds and bounded graph-adjacent context, against matched flat top-k retrieval using the same relevance-ranking stage and the same maximum number of retrieval units and tokens. The outcome is complete recovery of the official HotpotQA supporting-evidence set for each question.   Across 7,405 FullWiki questions, the Primary DBRR allocation increased complete supporting-evidence recovery by 23.8 percentage points over its matched flat baseline (paired risk difference 0.2377; question-level bootstrap 95% interval 0.2269 to 0.2489). It improved 1,952 questions, tied on 5,26

translated_title: 更多上下文，相同预算：超越Top-K检索的双界关系召回
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18448v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：更多上下文并不需要更大的检索预算。在相同的上限下，检索系统可以通过遵循平面top-k排名所遗漏的证据之间的关系，恢复问题所需的更多证据。我们通过双界关系召回（DBRR）来检验这一命题，该机制在相关性选择的种子和有界的图邻接上下文之间分配固定的检索预算，并与使用相同相关性排序阶段和相同最大检索单元及令牌数量的匹配平面top-k检索进行比较。结果是每个问题都能完全恢复官方HotpotQA支持证据集。在7,405个FullWiki问题中，主要DBRR分配使完全支持证据恢复率比其匹配的平面基线提高了23.8个百分点（配对风险差异0.2377；问题级自助法95%区间0.2269至0.2489）。它改善了1,952个问题，在5,26个问题上持平。
tldr: 本文提出双界关系召回（DBRR）方法，在相同检索预算下通过关系连接证据，显著提升HotpotQA支持证据的完整恢复率，比平面top-k检索提高23.8个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dual-Bounded Relational Recall (DBRR), which recovers more complete supporting evidence under the same retrieval budget by following relational connections, improving HotpotQA full-evidence recovery by 23.8 percentage points over flat top-k retrieval.
